raw_text: Amnesty International has documented evidence of ongoing Eritrean military operations in Tigray, Ethiopia, in violation of the November 2022 cessation of hostilities agreement. Our researchers have verified satellite imagery showing troop concentrations and spoken with displaced civilians who report continued abuses. We call on the international community to demand the immediate and verifiable withdrawal of all Eritrean forces from Ethiopian territory.
clean_text: Amnesty International documents ongoing Eritrean military operations in Tigray violating the ceasefire. Satellite imagery verified and civilian testimony collected. Calls for immediate Eritrean withdrawal.
